generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The new varargs `union` overload is fine functionally, but note that the existing two-argument `union(Set<T> left, Set<T> right)` method (visible in context) now duplicates logic. Consider having the two-arg version delegate to the new one (e.g., `return union(left, new Set[]{right})`) to avoid two separate implementations of the same operation drifting over time. This is a minor maintainability point, not a bug.

The constant `RESPONSE_PARAMS` and the method `responseParams(RestApiVersion)` in `BaseRestHandler` have very similar names but represent different things (a static set of always-supported response params vs. a version-dependent set). In the filter chain in #GBXEA, both are checked sequentially, which is correct, but the near-identical naming could trip up future readers. A slightly more distinctive name for the constant (e.g., `ALWAYS_RESPONSE_PARAMS` or `GLOBAL_RESPONSE_PARAMS`) might reduce confusion, though this is a stylistic suggestion.
